<ns0:uscDoc xmlns:ns0="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0 USLM-1.0.15.xsd" xml:lang="en" identifier="/us/usc/t15"><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdad7-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d"><ns0:num value="d" class="bold">(d)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Use of funds</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdad8-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Timing</ns0:heading><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdad9-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Expenses incurred</ns0:heading><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdada-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1/A/i"><ns0:num value="i" class="bold">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">Except as provided in clause (ii), amounts received under a grant under this section may be used for costs incurred during the period beginning on <ns0:date date="2020-03-01">March 1, 2020</ns0:date>, and ending on <ns0:date date="2021-12-31">December 31, 2021</ns0:date>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdadb-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1/A/ii"><ns0:num value="ii" class="bold">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Extension for supplemental grants</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">If an eligible person or entity receives a grant under subsection (b)(3), amounts received under either grant under this section may be used for costs incurred during the period beginning on <ns0:date date="2020-03-01">March 1, 2020</ns0:date>, and ending on <ns0:date date="2022-06-30">June 30, 2022</ns0:date>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdadc-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Expenditure</ns0:heading><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdadd-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1/B/i"><ns0:num value="i" class="bold">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">Except as provided in clause (ii), an eligible person or entity shall return to the Administrator any amounts received under a grant under this section that are not expended on or before the date that is 1 year after the date of disbursement of the grant.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdade-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/1/B/ii"><ns0:num value="ii" class="bold">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Extension for supplemental grants</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">If an eligible person or entity receives a grant under subsection (b)(3), the eligible person or entity shall return to the Administrator any amounts received under either grant under this section that are not expended on or before the date that is 18 months after the date of disbursement to the eligible person or entity of the grant under subsection (b)(2).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdadf-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Allowable expenses</ns0:heading><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdae0-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Definitions</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">In this paragraph—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae1-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/A/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the terms “covered mortgage obligation”, “covered rent obligation”, “covered utility payment”, and “covered worker protection expenditure” have the meanings given those terms in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t15/s636m/a">section 636m(a) of this title</ns0:ref>, as redesignated, transferred, and amended by this Act; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae2-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/A/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the term “payroll costs” has the meaning given that term in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t15/s636/a/36/A">section 636(a)(36)(A) of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdae3-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Expenses</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">An eligible person or entity may use amounts received under a grant under this section for—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae4-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> payroll costs;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae5-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> payments on any covered rent obligation;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae6-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/iii"><ns0:num value="iii">(iii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> any covered utility payment;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae7-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/iv"><ns0:num value="iv">(iv)</ns0:num><ns0:content> scheduled payments of interest or principal on any covered mortgage obligation (which shall not include any prepayment of principal on a covered mortgage obligation);</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae8-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/v"><ns0:num value="v">(v)</ns0:num><ns0:content> scheduled payments of interest or principal on any indebtedness or debt instrument (which shall not include any prepayment of principal) incurred in the ordinary course of business that is a liability of the eligible person or entity and was incurred prior to <ns0:date date="2020-02-15">February 15, 2020</ns0:date>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdae9-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/vi"><ns0:num value="vi">(vi)</ns0:num><ns0:content> covered worker protection expenditures;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdaea-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/vii"><ns0:num value="vii">(vii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> payments made to independent contractors, as reported on Form–1099 MISC, not to exceed a total of $100,000 in annual compensation for any individual employee of an independent contractor; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id6c7bdaeb-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii"><ns0:num value="viii">(viii)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> other ordinary and necessary business expenses, including—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id6c7bdaec-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii/I"><ns0:num value="I">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:content> maintenance expenses;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id6c7bdaed-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii/II"><ns0:num value="II">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:content> administrative costs, including fees and licensing costs;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id6c7bdaee-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii/III"><ns0:num value="III">(III)</ns0:num><ns0:content> State and local taxes and fees;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id6c7bdaef-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii/IV"><ns0:num value="IV">(IV)</ns0:num><ns0:content> operating leases in effect as of <ns0:date date="2020-02-15">February 15, 2020</ns0:date>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id6c7bdaf0-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii/V"><ns0:num value="V">(V)</ns0:num><ns0:content> payments required for insurance on any insurance policy; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id6c7bdaf1-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/2/B/viii/VI"><ns0:num value="VI">(VI)</ns0:num><ns0:content> advertising, production transportation, and capital expenditures related to producing a theatrical or live performing arts production, concert, exhibition, or comedy show, except that a grant under this section may not be used primarily for such expenditures.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id6c7bdaf2-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Prohibited expenses</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">An eligible person or entity may not use amounts received under a grant under this section—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id6c7bdaf3-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/3/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to purchase real estate;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id6c7bdaf4-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/3/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> for payments of interest or principal on loans originated after <ns0:date date="2020-02-15">February 15, 2020</ns0:date>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id6c7bdaf5-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/3/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to invest or re-lend funds;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id6c7bdaf6-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/3/D"><ns0:num value="D">(D)</ns0:num><ns0:content> for contributions or expenditures to, or on behalf of, any political party, party committee, or candidate for elective office; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id6c7bdaf7-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s9009a/d/3/E"><ns0:num value="E">(E)</ns0:num><ns0:content> for any other use as may be prohibited by the Administrator.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
</ns0:uscDoc>

oa:hasSelector.oa:exact: An eligible person or entity may use amounts received under a grant under this section for—

rkaf:assertsValue.@value: An eligible person or entity may use amounts received under a grant under this section for: (i) payroll costs; (ii) payments on any covered rent obligation; (iii) any covered utility payment; (iv) scheduled payments of interest or principal on any covered mortgage obligation (which shall not include any prepayment of principal on a covered mortgage obligation); (v) scheduled payments of interest or principal on any indebtedness or debt instrument (which shall not include any prepayment of principal) incurred in the ordinary course of business that is a liability of the eligible person or entity and was incurred prior to February 15, 2020; (vi) covered worker protection expenditures; (vii) payments made to independent contractors, as reported on Form–1099 MISC, not to exceed a total of $100,000 in annual compensation for any individual employee of an independent contractor; and (viii) other ordinary and necessary business expenses, including maintenance expenses, administrative costs (including fees and licensing costs), State and local taxes and fees, operating leases in effect as of February 15, 2020, payments required for insurance on any insurance policy, and advertising, production transportation, and capital expenditures related to producing a theatrical or live performing arts production, concert, exhibition, or comedy show, except that a grant under this section may not be used primarily for such expenditures.
